scripts.version: npm run version:sync && git add cli/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:native: npm run version:sync && cargo build --release --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml && node scripts/copy-native.js
scripts.build:macos: npm run version:sync && (cargo build --release --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-darwin & cargo build --release --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-apple-darwin & wait) && cp cli/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/stella-browser bin/stella-browser-darwin-arm64 && cp cli/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/stella-browser bin/stella-browser-darwin-x64 && codesign --force --sign - bin/stella-browser-darwin-arm64 && codesign --force --sign - bin/stella-browser-darwin-x64
scripts.build:linux: npm run version:sync && cargo zigbuild --release --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.2.28 --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.2.28 && cp cli/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/stella-browser bin/stella-browser-linux-x64 && cp cli/target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/stella-browser bin/stella-browser-linux-arm64
